# Code Anchors: Prose Verification

- `libs/prose-verify/src/verify.ts` — the single entry point returning one verdict over both properties, so no run can satisfy one and skip the other.
- `libs/prose-verify/src/regions.ts` — extracts the machine-read regions (frontmatter, fenced blocks, HTML comments, acceptance-criteria lines) and marks the lines the prose scan then skips.
- `libs/prose-verify/src/compare.ts` — the byte-identity comparison over those regions, pairing them by ordinal position within their own kind and reporting a surplus on either side.
- `libs/prose-verify/src/preserve.ts` — the preservation comparison: loss, count reduction, and unpermitted introduction, with grounding sources deciding what may be introduced.
- `libs/prose-verify/src/tokens.ts` — the four tracked classes: numerics keyed by denotation with zero and one excluded, modals paired across a bounded adverb run with their negation, the two-tier name-shaped set drawn from both copies, and structure counted by shape.
- `libs/prose-verify/src/render.ts` — renders the verdict, naming each missing or introduced item with its line so an author confirms or dismisses it quickly.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — declares the check as a verb on the shared executable; it survives this change for text the pipeline did not author, and no drafting stage invokes it any more.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — no longer scaffolds the ignore rule for the pre-translation copy, because no stage writes such a copy.
